description: mu-Tant composed-state round trip: a factory preset saved before the X-Mod redesign (APVTS dump + VoiceData, old xmod_fm / _am / _ring params) loads through the legacy rebuild + X-Mod migration, is saved in the composed format, and the re-render from that save must be sample-identical. The host session (getStateInformation → setStateInformation) must round-trip identically too.
